import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

# ---- same pipeline as iterations 1-2, now including GLH-3 and GLH-4 as within-family controls ----
ACCS={"GLH2":"Q966L9","GLH1":"P34689","GLH3":"O01836","GLH4":"O76743",
      "VASA":"P09052","DDX4":"Q9NQI0","LAF1":"D0PV95"}
S={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in ACCS.items()}
print({k:len(v) for k,v in S.items()})
b62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rows=b62.strip().split("\n");hdr=rows[0].split();AA={a:i for i,a in enumerate(hdr)}
M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in rows[1:]],float)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Sm=M62[np.ix_([AA.get(c,0) for c in s1],[AA.get(c,0) for c in s2])]
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mp,Xp,Yp=Mx[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1];row=Sm[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=row[j-1]
            c=(Mp[j-1]+s,Xp[j-1]+s,Yp[j-1]+s);k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2);Mx[i,j]=c[k];pM[i,j]=k
            cx=(Mp[j]+go,Xp[j]+ge,Yp[j]+go);k=0 if cx[0]>=cx[1] and cx[0]>=cx[2] else (1 if cx[1]>=cx[2] else 2);Ix[i,j]=cx[k];pX[i,j]=k
            cy=(Mx[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=0 if cy[0]>=cy[1] and cy[0]>=cy[2] else (1 if cy[1]>=cy[2] else 2);Iy[i,j]=cy[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[j-1]);st=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');st=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);st=pY[i,j];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))

VST,VEN=202,621; vsub=S["VASA"][VST-1:VEN]
# align the FULL query against the Vasa core so no core region is cut off (GLH-4 is 1156 aa)
QUERIES=["GLH1","GLH2","GLH3","GLH4","DDX4","LAF1"]
maps={}
for k in QUERIES:
    a,b=nw(S[k],vsub); qi=0;vi=VST-1;mp={}
    for ca,cb in zip(a,b):
        if ca!='-': qi+=1
        if cb!='-': vi+=1
        if ca!='-' and cb!='-': mp[vi]=(qi,ca)
    maps[k]=mp

ATP=[218,219,225,247,265,267,268,269,272,290,291,292,293,294,295,296,399,400,433,552,554,579,582,583]
RNA=[326,327,328,354,355,375,376,377,378,381,403,409,497,498,499,520,521,528,546,547,548]
# side-chain catalytic set: residues whose side chain directly performs or positions catalysis in 2DB3
CAT={272:"Q motif Q",294:"Walker A G",295:"Walker A K",296:"Walker A T",
     399:"motif II D (Mg2+)",400:"motif II E (catalytic water)",433:"motif III A",
     552:"motif V G",554:"motif V D",579:"motif VI R",582:"motif VI R"}
res=[]
for k in QUERIES:
    m=maps[k]
    a_id=sum(1 for p in ATP if p in m and m[p][1]==S["VASA"][p-1])
    r_id=sum(1 for p in RNA if p in m and m[p][1]==S["VASA"][p-1])
    c_id=sum(1 for p in CAT if p in m and m[p][1]==S["VASA"][p-1])
    cat_detail={CAT[p]:(f"{m[p][1]}{m[p][0]}" if p in m else "gap") for p in CAT}
    core_cols=[p for p in range(VST,VEN+1) if p in m]
    glob=sum(1 for p in core_cols if m[p][1]==S["VASA"][p-1])/max(len(core_cols),1)
    res.append({"protein":k,"len":len(S[k]),"core_cols_aligned":len(core_cols),
                "pct_id_core":round(100*glob,1),"ATP_contact_id":f"{a_id}/24","RNA_contact_id":f"{r_id}/21",
                "catalytic_sidechain_id":f"{c_id}/11", **cat_detail})
sc=pd.DataFrame(res)
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",40)
print("\n=== Within-family calibration: same pipeline applied to all four GLH paralogs ===")
print(sc[["protein","len","core_cols_aligned","pct_id_core","ATP_contact_id","RNA_contact_id","catalytic_sidechain_id"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== The 11 side-chain catalytic residues of Vasa, mapped onto each protein ===")
print(sc[["protein"]+list(CAT.values())].to_string(index=False))
sc.to_csv("glh_family_catalytic_scorecard.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.2))
labs=list(CAT.values()); order=["DDX4","LAF1","GLH1","GLH2","GLH3","GLH4"]
pretty={"DDX4":"DDX4 (human)","LAF1":"LAF-1 (worm, DDX3-like)","GLH1":"GLH-1","GLH2":"GLH-2","GLH3":"GLH-3","GLH4":"GLH-4"}
for i,k in enumerate(order):
    y=len(order)-1-i
    row=sc[sc.protein==k].iloc[0]
    ax.text(-0.75,y,pretty[k],ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10,
            fontweight="bold" if k=="GLH2" else "normal")
    for j,l in enumerate(labs):
        val=row[l]; vref=S["VASA"][[p for p in CAT if CAT[p]==l][0]-1]
        ok = val!="gap" and val[0]==vref
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j-0.45,y-0.4),0.9,0.8,fc="#2a6f4e" if ok else "#c0504d",ec="white",lw=1))
        ax.text(j,y,val,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,color="white",family="monospace")
for j,l in enumerate(labs):
    ax.text(j,len(order)-0.35,l,rotation=38,ha="left",va="bottom",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-6.5,len(labs)-0.2); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(order)+1.6); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("The 11 Vasa side chains that bind the nucleotide or perform catalysis, mapped onto the C. elegans GLH family\n"
             "green = identical to Vasa, red = substituted or unaligned",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
